question: Does the frozen L8/L9 aspectual module circuit predict and manipulate has-versus-had on two outcome-sealed constructions, and can the frozen L9H1/H4 pair replace whole attention layer 9?

frozen_constructions.A1: In the ledger, since/by last PERIOD, the AGENT -> has/had
frozen_constructions.A2: The witness remembers that since/by last PERIOD the AGENT -> has/had
frozen_constructions.P: period rewrite with anchor, final token, and answer held fixed
frozen_constructions.direction_balance: eight present-to-past and eight past-to-present groups

frozen_arms.intervention: simultaneous exact paired-native donor replacement at the matched final token

predictions.pred_a_native_capability: Every ordered A1, A2, P, and C cell passes the fixed native capability bars.
predictions.pred_b_module_bank_transfer: The four-module bank has A1 and A2 mean recovery at least 0.50 and direction fraction at least 0.80 in each, with P at most 0.20 and C at most 0.35.
predictions.pred_c_head_reduction: The H1/H4 head-reduced bank retains at least 80% of the four-module bank's mean target recovery and has positive A1/A2 mean recovery with direction fraction at least 0.80 in each.
predictions.pred_d_minimal_bank_report: The attention-minimal bank is reported under the same fixed bars but cannot rescue or invalidate the primary module-bank terminal.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All three arms produce all 64 row outcomes with finite logits; no row, construction, direction, or arm is dropped.

terminal.screen: A, B, and E pass. C and D are separately reported compression results.
terminal.null: The run is valid but the frozen four-module bank misses B.
terminal.invalid: Any authority, capability, coverage, finiteness, instrument, or execution check fails. No fresh prompt, answer, arm, head, threshold, or control may be changed after outcomes open.

novelty: First prospective construction transfer of the aspectual module circuit and first frozen replacement of its whole L9 attention write by the discovery-localized H1/H4 pair.
